node.title: The owner-free FPC5 moment flat is a full-rank Pade-Hankel kernel
node.statement: For the owner-free t-petal Cauchy chart, let mu_s be the weighted petal moment of X^s. The h-d-1 low-numerator equations on G=sum g_a X^a are exactly the full-row-rank Hankel system sum_a mu_(j+a)g_a=0. Its generating function is chi/Lambda at infinity and its moments satisfy the Lambda recurrence. Thus every surviving split locator is a monic degree-d divisor of the core locator inside one canonical Pade-Hankel kernel, with primitivity given by nonzero punctured first-row pairings; the remaining background Cauchy guards stay explicit.
